description:
The leopard seal hunts from under the Antarctic ice: it chased one of Shackleton's men across a floe in 1916, waits at the ice edge for penguins, strains krill through its teeth, has eaten most of a fur seal colony's pups, and sings for hours under the pack ice. Doug meets it on the ice, in a boat, in the water and, finally, underneath.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
